I've recently become intersted in learning Japanese ever since I've grown closer to my friend {FriendName}.
We met at a young age when her family moved from Japan to my neighborhood in the US.
We didn't get along at first.
Her assertive attitude and excess confidence in herself rubbed me the wrong way.
But as time passed by, and we grew older, we got used to one another, and became friends.
Now we're both 20-year-old college students, and we've become best friends to each other!
I played a big role in her English language journey, thought I never tried to learn Japanese seriously...
{PlayerName}! I found an exchange program that goes to Japan! We should do it together!
And so, my journey to learn Japanese... it's finally starting.
{FriendName} and I walk together through the hallways, getting used to our surroundings.
Even though we've been here for a few weeks already, it still feels so different from back home.
Yeah! It says here it's newly formed and they're looking for members.
I don't know... I'm not into Japanese fashion like you are.
Come on, it's gonna be fun!
But I'm not interested in your fashion kei whatever, {FriendName}!
Yeah, but it's not something I'm going to wear.
Are there even fashion trends for men?
{PlayerName} you've asked me that before, of course there are!
Don't you want to learn more japanese? You can meet Japanese people in here!
かのじょ も みつかる かも~
You know, a KANOJO? You've probably heard that word from me before...
Maybe, I don't remember it though.
Then let me spell it out for you. At this club, you can find you a G-I-R-L-F-R-I-E-N-D.
Seems like your face changed when I mentioned kanojo…
You definately want a kanojo, don't you?
Alright fine. But only to learn Japanese, not for any other reasons…
いらっしゃい !  Hello! Nice to meet ya! @
Are you guys interested in joining the club? @
Alright, you just need to sign here, and there please.
You can look around and hang out, we'll be starting our meeting soon.
Alright so... I joined, now I can leave, right?
I thought more people would be here...
It's a new club, from what I heard.
Oh look, another one is joining!
[Maybe Ayumi could say something like "This is the place!". Could be a good chance to show her personality/speaking style in a quick way.]
I look at the new girl… She's so…
My {FriendName}'s piercing gaze interrupt my thoughts.
What? No! What are you talking about?
Ah! Are you two the new exchange students, hello!
I'm {main_character name}, nice to meet you.
Are you also a transfer student, Ayumi?
Though my father is from the USA.
Do you come from the US?
Yeah, we do, although {friend} is originally from Japan, but she moved to the US to study.
Do you like fashion like Aoi?
Hai! I do, though I'm not very knowledgeble.
Yeah, she's an expert on that stuff.
It's starting! We should hurry to join them!
It was so nice meeting other people that are into J-fashion~ it's only our first day and I've already learned so many things!
うそつき! I'm sure you knew all that already.
Oh, so that word you do know?
Anyways, I'm going to talk to the President about something, I'll catch you outside.
Uhh, if you're asking if she's my sister, no, she's my best friend.
You do seem like good friends, haha.
We're pretty different though. She's crazy over fashion, while I'm…
You surely know more than me too...
I don't know, I've always seen kawaii-fashion and knew it existed, but it's when I tried it on that something felt like it just clicked.
I've bought a few pieces, but I'm no expert.
I'm sure your outfits look great!
Ah, the President needs to lock the room, we should go, it was nice to meet you!
What if I help you get accessories for your next outfit?
Just so I can learn a bit more, you know?
You want choose my next oufit?
No no, not choose, just pick out an accessory for you.
I just want to immerse myself in the Japanese language.
So you just have to send me a website and I'll check it out!
I think I'm okay with that!
I'll give you my number just in case.
I'll send you the link when I choose it.
is Aoi not coming to the meetup, [main_character name]?
I'm not sure, I thought she was already here.
Taking a look at her outfit, I feel my cheeks burning.
I was not expecting her to look so pretty…
At least Aoi is not here.
I wouldn't want her to see me like this, how embarrassing.
What you bought fit me very well, thank you so much!
No problem! It helped me learn some Japanese so I don't mind.
I think I said it right.
Hey, Aoi, I'm glad you made it!
I lost track of time and almost didn't make it, but I did.
I'm glad you made it too, Aoi!
After a few group activities, the presdent says their goodbyes and the other members leave as well.
It's cool to learn about Japanese culture.
And also listen to you guys talk in Japanese even though I don't understand half of it, haha.
You'll get there one day, keep practicing!
Actually, I was thinking, if you had the time...
Could help me practice my japanese skills?
Well, I don't know, talk to me about yourself, but in Japanese and I'll try to figure out what you're saying.
Konbanwa, watashi no namae wa ayumi desu
[in japanese] I'm 20 years old, I'm half-japanese but born In japan
Hold up you lost me there.
Nono I said I'm half-japanese but born in Japan
[JP] I like dressups, singing, dancing, and watching anime, of course.
I love anime too, I'm such a fan of shonen like Jujustu Kaisen, Black Clover, One Punch Man…
They're really cool, you should watch them.
My friend Aoi watched them with me but she says it's not her type.
I'll have to agree with her, unfortunately.
I'm more into romance or slice of life animes.
YES! Oh maybe your Japanese is not so bad after all.
But hear me out, if you can sing, my favorite anime's intro…
No, but what do you usually like to sing?
I haven't sung in a while, actually…
Oh, really. May I ask why?
I don't want to get into it right now.
The two of you stay quiet for a few seconds.
Yeah, they did a while ago.
But it's fun talking with you, [PlayerName]
I have an idea! I'll shoot some words at you and you tell me what you think they mean in English, yes?
Based on how well you did:
You'll get better with more practice I'm sure.
So, since I chose your accessory correctly this time.
Would you like some help choosing your next outfit?
Hontou? (idk if we have a blushing expression but it would be nice) @
For next time I was thinking a more casual style
Since I think the next meetup we're going to the cinema, then I want to be comfortable
I think I already have something in mind.
Great! If you have any questions you can text me too ;)
Pfft, im an expert already, come on.
Alright then, I'll see you next week!
I know, I know. I know I'm late, I just uhh…
Hey [main_character name], good to see you! @
It was definitely thanks to you though, you were a great help!
I look at Aoi with a serious look, hoping she can read my mind
"Don't embarrass me in front of her!"
However, Ayumi doesnt seem to notice
Also, Aoi, that makes us even.
You definitely arrived later than I did last time!
Also, how did you do on your test?
Of course you are very smart, {friend}.
You hang out with me, that's smart.
You look like you're really good friends talking to each other like that. @
[main_character name] is my bestie, he's a really good person.
He helped me a lot when I was starting to learn English.
Well... when we started getting along. At first he didn't stand me, right?
It's big thanks to him that I'm able to speak English so fluently.
That sounds really nice of you, [main_character name] @
It seems you guys were talking but we're about to start.
Lolita fashion isn't just about asthetic but also empowerment, and freedom.
It's really interesting learning about this.
Alright guys, I need to leave now if I want to make it to the movies.
I take a lot of time getting dressed, haha.
But I look good, don't I?
I think im going to stay here a bit and enjoy the breeze.
I sit down in the grass (maybe sound effect)
I really like sitting down and just feeling the breeze you know?
My friends usually just hang out playing videogames, going to the movies…
What about you? What do you like to do with your friends?
Watching movies, dining out, going to arcades, talking, it varies.
But I get you. Not everyone wants to just chill.
I catch myself staring at Ayumi's hair moving with the wind.
Can I ask you a weird question?
You can't be yourself with your friends?
Hmm, I don't think so, no.
Especially not with friend, she's my best friend.
Well… I don't have to share everything about me with them, you know?
It depends on how much trust I have in them.
I feel like my friends would mock me if they knew I went to a fashion club…
Isn't fashion like something big in Japan?
It is, but I don't know...
Nah, I'm sure they won't mock you!
Especially if they're good friends like {friend} is to me
I'm not that close with any of my friends.
I could never joke around like that haha.
I think you should give a shot still!
Tell them, and see how they react.
I'm sure they'll be more than okay with it.
Anyhow, I think we better get going to the movies, or we'll be late.
I think it's cool you like fashion. It fits you really well.
[choice – tell her she looks pretty or not]
Really odd that Ayumi wasnt here. She said she would be here…
When you walk out of the meeting room, you see Ayumi walking by
Yeah… I wasn't feeling good today.
I don't really want to talk about that here…
I was just going to go out to buy myself something.
The more the merrier, as you americans say
We arrive at the coffee shop and Aoi helps me order a cup of tea for myself and for her.
The three of you sit down
{friend name} Told me she'll be here soon.
I told my friends… like you said.
And most of them were excited about it.
He said it's childish, and that I have to grow up now that I'm a college student…
Oh I meant he's an idiot. Sorry
But why would he say that?
But I thought he'd be happy for me, you know?
But the rest of your friends were supportive, no?
It reminded me of when I was little...
When I was little, I wanted to be a singer…
I wasn't the best, but… I tried
And I was really happy doing so.
And my parents both supported me.
But my best friend at the time, he…
There was a ongaku happyokai at school, a music recital. And I wanted to participate
I wasn't used to being in front of an audience, it was gonna be my first time
So when my turn came, I walked over the microphone shaking
I grabbed it and started singing…
And I felt something bit my foot
I dropped the mic and it fell in my foot!
when I kneeled down to grab the mic, I saw my friend laughing
and I was just a kid, so of course… It hurt me
I started singing again, and when I watched him him, he was still laughing!
And the more I cried, the harder he laughed!
So I stopped singing for a while…
And made some new friends after some time.
Which treated me well, but I still felt afraid to be mocked like that again.
But I've been trying to trust people again, it's just…
Yeah I know, especially when they don't prove you wrong
I wanted to go to the reunion today, but I wasn't feeling good.
Hopefully that tea will calm you down.
Yeah… I really love their chamomile tea.
That’s why I came here. It always helps me relax.
I don’t usually drink much coffee, so having something like this is nice.
Same. And since it’s caffeine-free, I don’t have to worry about it keeping me awake tonight.
How are you liking Japanese fashion? Are you starting to enjoy it?
It's definitely interesting! I didn't know there were so many substyles of Lolita fashion.
It made hard choosing an accesory for you, but I think I've done pretty well, don't you think?
It's exciting to have some pick out an item for me!
No one has ever done that for me before~
That's only because you haven't told anyone you liked fashion.
I hear the door of the coffee shop opening.
I got stuck in traffic on the way here.
Yeah, that happens, especially at this hour.
We were just talking about Japanese fashion being my newfound skill
Even though I’m probably not the one you’re trying to impress.
I give Aoi a warning look and deliberately clear my throat.
Judging by her expression, she hadn’t heard Aoi’s comment. What a relief.
Yeah, I’m fine. I just had something in my throat.
{FriendName}, could you tell me what happened at the club today?friend name} do you mind giving me a run down on what happened in the club today?
Why did you want to learn Japanese? I'm curious.
It started as a joke with {FriendName}
Because she used to talk to me in japanese to upset me cuz I didn't know what she was saying
And I told her I would learn Japanese
It seemed like an interesting language
I just didin't have the motivation to learn it yet.
Until she told me about the exchange program.
I wanted to know a bit since I was gonna be talking with Japanese people, you know?
But it's fair to say that it's not easy
Aww, yes it can be hard
Especially if you haven't been introduced to any other languages.
I take the last sip of my tea, which has already gotten cold.
[prompt last website 3 minigame → in the minigame ayumi will tell you about the big fashion event at the mall. If it doesn't end up happening, then ill add the dialogue here]
Did I choose the wrong outfit? Is she mad at me?
Being anxious is so unlike me…
I look at the other people that have gathered here. They all wear different fashion styles.
While I look for costume similar to the one Ayumi will be wearing, I hear my phone ring in my pocket.
Oh oh, I think I see you.
Before you can turn around, Ayumi walks in front of you, wearing the dress you picked out for her.
I hold myself back before I say something embarrassing.
I really like the outfit you chose for me.
Ah, it's nothing. I'm glad you like it.
I've become quite the fashionist, right?
I didn't know you'd be here.
I just came to say hi and buy some things.
Now that we're here, just the two of us…
Does that make this… a date?
Sorry, that caught me off guard.
I feel we've been friends for a while now…
And you know, since you've been so nice to me, helping me choose my outfits.
I thought that meant that you like me.
I never thought this would happen...
Not that I didn't want this or anything, but…
Hai. I like you... a lot~
Why did I have to say it like that?
I was afraid to be wrong, so I cheated a little bit.
To help me get past my nervousness.
I'm gonna have a talk with her once I get home…
She is in so much trouble…
Ayumi and I look at each other and laugh.
So… do you want to walk around with me?
